title: Invalid result value and corrected re-drive
summary: An instrument result was rejected because of a malformed value. Find the defect in the raw payload, preview the supplied correction, and re-drive it while preserving the original.

steps.note: Create a new, empty synthetic exercise database. init refuses a path that already exists.
Register synthetic patient SYN-EX03-01, AML/MDS FISH order ACC-EX03-0001, and an accessioned bone-marrow specimen.
Ingest the instrument result for ACC-EX03-0001; the message does not file.
